$fixture.notes: Not one of the 12 B7 boundary codes — this is the adjacent-domain code from design §9.6. Mutations elsewhere in the product (group membership, role bindings, project deletion) that would change a boundary's effect must refuse and hand back an impactPreviewUrl rather than silently altering the boundary's blast radius. The nearest existing behavior is isConstraintBearingGroup (pkg/hub/handlers_groups.go:912-938), which already blocks constraint-bearing group changes but returns a plain 409 conflict with no preview link. Included because F7 consumes it.
